species.name: Bulbasaur
species.description: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

species.name: Ivysaur
species.description: There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.

species.name: Venusaur
species.description: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.

species.name: Charmander
species.description: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

species.name: Charmeleon
species.description: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

species.name: Charizard
species.description: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

species.name: Squirtle
species.description: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

species.name: Wartortle
species.description: This Pokémon is very popular as a pet. Its fur-covered tail is a symbol of its longevity.

species.name: Blastoise
species.description: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

species.name: Caterpie
species.description: It is covered with a green skin. When it grows, it sheds the skin, covers itself with silk, and becomes a cocoon.

species.name: Metapod
species.description: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can’t withstand a harsh attack.

species.name: Butterfree
species.description: The wings are protected by rain-repellent dust. As a result, this Pokémon can fly about even in rain.

species.name: Weedle
species.description: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

species.name: Kakuna
species.description: This Pokémon is in a temporary stage while making its body. It is almost completely unable to move on its own.

species.name: Beedrill
species.description: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

species.name: Pidgey
species.description: Does not like to fight. It hides in tall grass and so on, foraging for food such as small bugs.

species.name: Pidgeotto
species.description: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an EXEGGCUTE to its nest over 60 miles away.

species.name: Pidgeot
species.description: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate enemies. It races through the skies at Mach-2 speed.

species.name: Rattata
species.description: Its fangs are long and very sharp. They grow continuously, so it gnaws on hard things to whittle them down.

species.name: Raticate
species.description: Its rear feet have three toes each. They are webbed, enabling it to swim across rivers.

species.name: Spearow
species.description: It busily flits around here and there. Even if it is frail, it can be a tough foe that uses MIRROR MOVE.

species.name: Fearow
species.description: Its huge and magnificent wings can keep it aloft in the sky. It can remain flying a whole day without landing.

species.name: Ekans
species.description: A very common sight in grassland, etc. It flicks its tongue in and out to sense danger in its surroundings.

species.name: Arbok
species.description: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

species.name: Pikachu
species.description: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

species.name: Raichu
species.description: Its electric charges can reach even 100,000 volts. Careless contact can cause even an Indian elephant to faint.

species.name: Sandshrew
species.description: It burrows and lives underground. If threatened, it curls itself up into a ball for protection.

species.name: Sandslash
species.description: It is adept at attacking with the spines on its back and its sharp claws while quickly scurrying about.

species.name: Nidoran♀
species.description: Though small, it must be treated with caution because of its powerfully toxic barbs. The female has smaller horns.

species.name: Nidorina
species.description: The female has a gentle temperament. It emits ultrasonic cries that have the power to befuddle foes.

species.name: Nidoqueen
species.description: The body is covered by stiff, needle- like scales. If it becomes excited, the needles bristle outwards.

species.name: Nidoran♂
species.description: Its large ears are flapped like wings when it is listening to distant sounds. It extends toxic barbs when angered.

species.name: Nidorino
species.description: It is easily angered. By swinging its well- developed horn wildly, it can even punch through diamond.

species.name: Nidoking
species.description: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn as it contains venom.

species.name: Clefairy
species.description: Its adorable appearance makes it popular as a pet. However, it is rare and difficult to find.

species.name: Clefable
species.description: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.

species.name: Vulpix
species.description: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

species.name: Ninetales
species.description: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.

species.name: Jigglypuff
species.description: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.

species.name: Wigglytuff
species.description: Its fur is extremely fine, dense, and supple. The exquisitely pleasant fur conveys an image of luxury.

species.name: Zubat
species.description: It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on its ultrasonic cries for echo location to flit about in darkness.

species.name: Golbat
species.description: It clamps down on its prey with needle- sharp fangs and drains over 10 ounces of blood in one gulp.

species.name: Oddish
species.description: Its scientific name is “Oddium Wanderus.” At night, it is said to walk nearly 1,000 feet on its two roots.

species.name: Gloom
species.description: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

species.name: Vileplume
species.description: Its petals are the largest in the world. It fiendishly scatters allergy-causing pollen from its petals.

species.name: Paras
species.description: Growing out of the bug’s back are mushrooms called tochukaso. The mushrooms grow with the bug host.

species.name: Parasect
species.description: It scatters toxic spores from the mushroom cap. In China, the spores are used as herbal medicine.

species.name: Venonat
species.description: Its eyes act as radar, enabling it to be active in darkness. The eyes can also shoot powerful beams.

species.name: Venomoth
species.description: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

species.name: Diglett
species.description: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

species.name: Dugtrio
species.description: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

species.name: Meowth
species.description: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

species.name: Persian
species.description: Has a vicious temperament. Beware if it raises its tail straight up. It is a signal that it is about to pounce and bite.

species.name: Psyduck
species.description: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

species.name: Golduck
species.description: The forelegs are webbed, helping to make it an adept swimmer. It can be seen swimming elegantly in lakes, etc.

species.name: Mankey
species.description: Light and agile on its feet, and ferocious in temperament. When angered, it flies into an uncontrollable frenzy.

species.name: Primeape
species.description: It is always outrageously furious. If it gives chase, it will tenaciously track the target no matter how far.

species.name: Growlithe
species.description: Very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

species.name: Arcanine
species.description: A Pokémon that is described in Chinese legends. It is said to race at an unbelievable speed.

species.name: Poliwag
species.description: Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.

species.name: Poliwhirl
species.description: Its two legs are well developed. Even though it can live on the ground, it prefers living in water.

species.name: Poliwrath
species.description: An adept swimmer, it knows the front crawl, butterfly, and more. It is faster than the best human swimmers.

species.name: Abra
species.description: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a variety of extrasensory powers even while asleep.

species.name: Kadabra
species.description: It happened one morning - a boy with extrasensory powers awoke in bed transformed into KADABRA.

species.name: Alakazam
species.description: It does not like physical attacks very much. Instead, it freely uses extra sensory powers to defeat foes.

species.name: Machop
species.description: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it’s the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

species.name: Machoke
species.description: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.

species.name: Machamp
species.description: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.

species.name: Bellsprout
species.description: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

species.name: Weepinbell
species.description: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

species.name: Victreebel
species.description: Lures prey into its mouth with a honeylike aroma. The helpless prey is melted with a dissolving fluid.

species.name: Tentacool
species.description: Its eyes are as transparent as crystals. From them, it shoots mysterious beams of light.

species.name: Tentacruel
species.description: It has 80 tentacles that move about freely. They can sting, causing poisoning and sharp, stabbing pain.

species.name: Geodude
species.description: Its round form makes it easy to pick up. Some people have used them to hurl at each other in a snowball fight.

species.name: Graveler
species.description: Be careful while hiking on mountain trails. GRAVELER may come rolling down the path without slowing.

species.name: Golem
species.description: It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin once a year to grow larger.

species.name: Ponyta
species.description: Its body is light, and its legs are incredibly powerful. It can clear Ayers Rock in one leap.

species.name: Rapidash
species.description: It can gallop at a top speed of 150 miles per hour. It can race as fast as a bullet train while ablaze.

species.name: Slowpoke
species.description: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

species.name: Slowbro
species.description: When a SLOWPOKE went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a SHELLDER. That made it evolve into SLOWBRO.

species.name: Magnemite
species.description: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges THUNDER WAVE and so on from the units at its sides.

species.name: Magneton
species.description: A linked cluster formed of several MAGNEMITE. It discharges powerful magnetic waves at high voltage.

species.name: Farfetch’d
species.description: It always walks about with a plant stalk clamped in its beak. The stalk is used for building its nest.

species.name: Doduo
species.description: A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.

species.name: Dodrio
species.description: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

species.name: Seel
species.description: Covered with light blue fur, its hide is thick and tough. It is active in bitter cold of minus 40 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.name: Dewgong
species.description: Its body is covered with a pure white fur. The colder the weather, the more active it becomes.

species.name: Grimer
species.description: Sludge exposed to X rays from the moon transformed into GRIMER. It loves feeding on filthy things.

species.name: Muk
species.description: It is usually undetectable because it blends in with the ground. Touching it can cause terrible poisoning.

species.name: Shellder
species.description: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

species.name: Cloyster
species.description: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.

species.name: Gastly
species.description: A being that exists as a thin gas. It can topple an Indian elephant by enveloping the prey in two seconds.

species.name: Haunter
species.description: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, HAUNTER is there.

species.name: Gengar
species.description: It is said to emerge from darkness to steal the lives of those who become lost in mountains.

species.name: Onix
species.description: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

species.name: Drowzee
species.description: A descendent of the legendary animal baku, which is said to eat dreams. It is skilled at hypnotism.

species.name: Hypno
species.description: It carries a pendulum-like device. There once was an incident in which it took away a child it hypnotized.

species.name: Krabby
species.description: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

species.name: Kingler
species.description: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

species.name: Voltorb
species.description: A life-form whose identity is unknown. It is said to SCREECH or suddenly SELFDESTRUCT.

species.name: Electrode
species.description: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of “The Bomb Ball.”

species.name: Exeggcute
species.description: Even though it appears to be eggs of some sort, it was discovered to be a life- form more like plant seeds.

species.name: Exeggutor
species.description: It is called “The Walking Tropical Rainforest.” Each of the nuts has a face and a will of its own.

species.name: Cubone
species.description: It wears the skull of its dead mother on its head. When it becomes lonesome, it is said to cry loudly.

species.name: Marowak
species.description: It is small and was originally very weak. Its temperament turned ferocious when it began using bones.

species.name: Hitmonlee
species.description: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

species.name: Hitmonchan
species.description: The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this Pokémon. It throws punches that are faster than a bullet train.

species.name: Lickitung
species.description: Its tongue is twice the length of its body. It can be moved like an arm for grabbing food and attacking.

species.name: Koffing
species.description: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

species.name: Weezing
species.description: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small KOFFING twins becoming conjoined as a WEEZING.

species.name: Rhyhorn
species.description: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging TACKLES.

species.name: Rhydon
species.description: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.

species.name: Chansey
species.description: It lays several eggs a day. The eggs are apparently rich in nutrients and extremely delicious.

species.name: Tangela
species.description: Blue plant vines cloak the Pokémon’s identity in a tangled mass. It entangles anything that gets close.

species.name: Kangaskhan
species.description: The female raises its offspring in a pouch on its belly. It is skilled at attacking using COMET PUNCH.

species.name: Horsea
species.description: It maintains balance using its tail, which is wound up like a coil. It may spray ink from its mouth.

species.name: Seadra
species.description: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.

species.name: Goldeen
species.description: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.

species.name: Seaking
species.description: The horn on its head is sharp like a drill. It bores a hole in a boulder to make its nest.

species.name: Staryu
species.description: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

species.name: Starmie
species.description: This Pokémon has a geometric body. Because of its body, the locals suspect that it is an alien creature.

species.name: Mr. Mime
species.description: It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.

species.name: Scyther
species.description: It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its wings to fly.

species.name: Jynx
species.description: It speaks using a language that sounds human. Research is under way to determine what is being said.

species.name: Electabuzz
species.description: It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally appears around large power plants and so on.

species.name: Magmar
species.description: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather’s body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.name: Pinsir
species.description: Its two long pincer horns are powerful. Once they grip an enemy, they won’t release until the foe is torn.

species.name: Tauros
species.description: When it is about to TACKLE, it whips its body repeatedly with its three long tails.

species.name: Magikarp
species.description: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.

species.name: Gyarados
species.description: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The HYPER BEAM it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

species.name: Lapras
species.description: Its high intelligence enables it to understand human speech. It likes to ferry people on its back.

species.name: Ditto
species.description: It can freely recombine its own cellular structure to transform into other life- forms.

species.name: Eevee
species.description: An extremely rare Pokémon that may evolve in a number of different ways depending on stimuli.

species.name: Vaporeon
species.description: Its body’s cellular structure is similar to the molecular composition of water. It can melt invisibly in water.

species.name: Jolteon
species.description: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.

species.name: Flareon
species.description: It has a flame bag inside its body. After inhaling deeply, it blows out flames of nearly 3,100 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.name: Porygon
species.description: Using the most advanced technologies, scientists finally succeeded in making the first artificial Pokémon.

species.name: Omanyte
species.description: A prehistoric Pokémon that lived in the primordial sea, it swims by twisting its 10 tentacles about.

species.name: Omastar
species.description: Its tentacles are highly developed as if they are hands and feet. As soon as it ensnares prey, it bites.

species.name: Kabuto
species.description: This Pokémon was regenerated from the fossil of an ancient creature. It protects itself with a hard shell.

species.name: Kabutops
species.description: It swims freely through water. It catches prey with its scythe-like arms and drains the victim’s fluids.

species.name: Aerodactyl
species.description: It was regenerated from a dinosaur’s genetic matter that was found in amber. It flies with high-pitched cries.

species.name: Snorlax
species.description: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

species.name: Articuno
species.description: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. With its long tail trailing behind, its flying form is magnificent.

species.name: Zapdos
species.description: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. While it is flying, it makes crackling and snapping sounds.

species.name: Moltres
species.description: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. Those seeing it are overwhelmed by its orange wings that seem to be on fire.

species.name: Dratini
species.description: Even the young can exceed 6.5 feet in length. It grows larger by repeatedly shedding skin.

species.name: Dragonair
species.description: It is said to live in seas and lakes. Even though it has no wings, it has been seen flying occasionally.

species.name: Dragonite
species.description: It can fly in spite of its big and bulky physique. It circles the globe in just 16 hours.

species.name: Mewtwo
species.description: A Pokémon whose genetic code was repeatedly recombined for research. It turned vicious as a result.

species.name: Mew
species.description: A Pokémon of South America that was thought to have been extinct. It is very intelligent and learns any move.

species.name: Chikorita
species.description: Its pleasantly aromatic leaves have the ability to check the humidity and temperature.

species.name: Bayleef
species.description: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

species.name: Meganium
species.description: MEGANIUM’s breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

species.name: Cyndaquil
species.description: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

species.name: Quilava
species.description: This Pokémon is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

species.name: Typhlosion
species.description: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

species.name: Totodile
species.description: It is small but rough and tough. It won’t hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

species.name: Croconaw
species.description: It opens its huge jaws wide when attacking. If it loses any fangs while biting, they grow back in.

species.name: Feraligatr
species.description: It is hard for it to support its own weight out of water, so it gets down on all fours. But it moves fast.

species.name: Sentret
species.description: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.

species.name: Furret
species.description: There is no telling where its tail begins. Despite its short legs, it is quick at hunting RATTATA.

species.name: Hoothoot
species.description: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

species.name: Noctowl
species.description: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

species.name: Ledyba
species.description: When the weather turns cold, numerous LEDYBA gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.

species.name: Ledian
species.description: The star patterns on its back grow larger or smaller depending on the number of stars in the night sky.

species.name: Spinarak
species.description: It spins a web using fine--but durable-- thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.

species.name: Ariados
species.description: A single strand of a special string is endlessly spun out of its rear. The string leads back to its nest.

species.name: Crobat
species.description: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.

species.name: Chinchou
species.description: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

species.name: Lanturn
species.description: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.

species.name: Pichu
species.description: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

species.name: Cleffa
species.description: When numerous meteors illuminate the night sky, sightings of CLEFFA strangely increase.

species.name: Igglybuff
species.description: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously--anytime, anywhere.

species.name: Togepi
species.description: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping TOGEPI stand up.

species.name: Togetic
species.description: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

species.name: Natu
species.description: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

species.name: Xatu
species.description: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.

species.name: Mareep
species.description: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

species.name: Flaaffy
species.description: Its fluffy fleece easily stores electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it from being electrocuted.

species.name: Ampharos
species.description: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.

species.name: Bellossom
species.description: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

species.name: Marill
species.description: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.

species.name: Azumarill
species.description: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from getting wet.

species.name: Sudowoodo
species.description: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

species.name: Politoed
species.description: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

species.name: Hoppip
species.description: Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.

species.name: Skiploom
species.description: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

species.name: Jumpluff
species.description: It drifts on seasonal winds and spreads its cotton-like spores all over the world to make more offspring.

species.name: Aipom
species.description: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

species.name: Sunkern
species.description: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.

species.name: Sunflora
species.description: In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic manner, but it comes to a complete stop when the sun sets.

species.name: Yanma
species.description: Its large eyes can scan 360 degrees. It looks in all directions to seek out insects as its prey.

species.name: Wooper
species.description: When it walks around on the ground, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.

species.name: Quagsire
species.description: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

species.name: Espeon
species.description: By reading air currents, it can predict things such as the weather or its foe’s next move.

species.name: Umbreon
species.description: When darkness falls, the rings on its body begin to glow, striking fear in the hearts of anyone nearby.

species.name: Murkrow
species.description: It is said that when chased, it lures its attacker onto dark mountain trails where the foe will get lost.

species.name: Slowking
species.description: When its head was bitten, toxins entered SLOWPOKE’s head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

species.name: Misdreavus
species.description: It loves to bite and yank people’s hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

species.name: Unown
species.description: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

species.name: Wobbuffet
species.description: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

species.name: Girafarig
species.description: Its tail, which also contains a small brain, may bite on its own if it notices an alluring smell.

species.name: Pineco
species.description: It hangs and waits for flying-insect prey to come near. It does not move about much on its own.

species.name: Forretress
species.description: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

species.name: Dunsparce
species.description: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can hover just slightly using its wings.

species.name: Gligar
species.description: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

species.name: Steelix
species.description: It is said that if an ONIX lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

species.name: Snubbull
species.description: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

species.name: Granbull
species.description: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its BITE is powerful.

species.name: Qwilfish
species.description: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.

species.name: Scizor
species.description: Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.

species.name: Shuckle
species.description: It stores BERRIES inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

species.name: Heracross
species.description: Usually docile, but if disturbed while sipping honey, it chases off the intruder with its horn.

species.name: Sneasel
species.description: Vicious in nature, it drives PIDGEY from their nests and feasts on the eggs that are left behind.

species.name: Teddiursa
species.description: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

species.name: Ursaring
species.description: With its ability to distinguish any smell, it unfailingly finds all food buried deep underground.

species.name: Slugma
species.description: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

species.name: Magcargo
species.description: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

species.name: Swinub
species.description: If it smells something enticing, it dashes off headlong to find the source of the aroma.

species.name: Piloswine
species.description: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

species.name: Corsola
species.description: In a south sea nation, the people live in communities that are built on groups of these Pokémon.

species.name: Remoraid
species.description: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a MANTINE’s underside to scavenge for leftovers.

species.name: Octillery
species.description: It instinctively sneaks into rocky holes. If it gets sleepy, it steals the nest of a fellow OCTILLERY.

species.name: Delibird
species.description: It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs. It spends all day carrying food to its awaiting chicks.

species.name: Mantine
species.description: Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly out of the water and over the waves if it builds up enough speed.

species.name: Skarmory
species.description: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

species.name: Houndour
species.description: To corner prey, they check each other’s location using barks that only they can understand.

species.name: Houndoom
species.description: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

species.name: Kingdra
species.description: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

species.name: Phanpy
species.description: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.

species.name: Donphan
species.description: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take a long time to grow.

species.name: Porygon2
species.description: Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.

species.name: Stantler
species.description: Those who stare at its antlers will gradually lose control of their senses and be unable to stand.

species.name: Smeargle
species.description: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

species.name: Tyrogue
species.description: Even though it is small, it can’t be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

species.name: Hitmontop
species.description: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

species.name: Smoochum
species.description: It always rocks its head slowly backwards and forwards as if it is trying to kiss someone.

species.name: Elekid
species.description: Even in the most vicious storm, this Pokémon plays happily if thunder rumbles in the sky.

species.name: Magby
species.description: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body heat exceeds 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit, so don’t underestimate it.

species.name: Miltank
species.description: If it has just had a baby, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.

species.name: Blissey
species.description: It has a very compassionate nature. If it sees a sick Pokémon, it will nurse the sufferer back to health.

species.name: Raikou
species.description: This Pokémon races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.

species.name: Entei
species.description: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

species.name: Suicune
species.description: This Pokémon races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.

species.name: Larvitar
species.description: It is born deep underground. It can’t emerge until it has entirely consumed the soil around it.

species.name: Pupitar
species.description: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

species.name: Tyranitar
species.description: Its body can’t be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

species.name: Lugia
species.description: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

species.name: Ho-Oh
species.description: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

species.name: Celebi
species.description: When CELEBI disappears deep in a forest, it is said to leave behind an egg it brought from the future.

species.name: Treecko
species.description: It quickly scales even vertical walls. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day’s weather.

species.name: Grovyle
species.description: Its strongly developed thigh muscles give it astounding agility and jumping performance.

species.name: Sceptile
species.description: The leaves on its forelegs are as sharp as swords. It agilely leaps about the branches of trees to strike.

species.name: Torchic
species.description: It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.

species.name: Combusken
species.description: It boosts its concentration by emitting harsh cries. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

species.name: Blaziken
species.description: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

species.name: Mudkip
species.description: Its large tail fin propels it through water with powerful acceleration. It is strong in spite of its size.

species.name: Marshtomp
species.description: It is at its best when on muddy ground with poor footing. It quickly overwhelms foes struggling in mud.

species.name: Swampert
species.description: Its arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down its foe. It makes its nest on beautiful beaches.

species.name: Poochyena
species.description: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

species.name: Mightyena
species.description: It will always obey the commands of a skilled TRAINER. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

species.name: Zigzagoon
species.description: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigs and zags.

species.name: Linoone
species.description: When running in a straight line, it can top 60 miles per hour. However, it has a tough time with curved roads.

species.name: Wurmple
species.description: It lives amidst tall grass and in forests. When attacked, it resists by pointing its venomous spikes at the foe.

species.name: Silcoon
species.description: It conserves its energy by moving as little as possible. It awaits evolution while drinking only a little rainwater.

species.name: Beautifly
species.description: Despite its appearance, it has an aggressive nature. It attacks by jabbing with its long, thin mouth.

species.name: Cascoon
species.description: Its body, which is made of soft silk, hardens over time. When cracks appear, evolution is near.

species.name: Dustox
species.description: It scatters horribly toxic dust when it senses danger. They tend to gather in the glow of streetlamps at night.

species.name: Lotad
species.description: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

species.name: Lombre
species.description: It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

species.name: Ludicolo
species.description: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates LUDICOLO’s cells, making it more powerful.

species.name: Seedot
species.description: If it remains still, it becomes impossible to distinguish from real nuts. It delights in surprising foraging PIDGEY.

species.name: Nuzleaf
species.description: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of NUZLEAF’s grass flute fills listeners with dread.

species.name: Shiftry
species.description: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe’s mind and take preemptive action.

species.name: Taillow
species.description: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.

species.name: Swellow
species.description: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.

species.name: Wingull
species.description: It rides upon ocean winds as if it were a glider. In the winter, it hides food around its nest.

species.name: Pelipper
species.description: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

species.name: Ralts
species.description: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

species.name: Kirlia
species.description: The cheerful spirit of its TRAINER gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

species.name: Gardevoir
species.description: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its TRAINER.

species.name: Surskit
species.description: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.

species.name: Masquerain
species.description: The antennae have distinctive patterns that look like eyes. When it rains, they grow heavy, making flight impossible.

species.name: Shroomish
species.description: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

species.name: Breloom
species.description: The seeds on its tail are made of toxic spores. It knocks out foes with quick, virtually invisible punches.

species.name: Slakoth
species.description: It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making drowsy those that see it is one of its abilities.

species.name: Vigoroth
species.description: It is always hungry because it won’t stop rampaging. Even while it is eating, it can’t keep still.

species.name: Slaking
species.description: It is the world’s most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

species.name: Nincada
species.description: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.

species.name: Ninjask
species.description: This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.

species.name: Shedinja
species.description: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a POKé BALL when a NINCADA evolves.

species.name: Whismur
species.description: It usually murmurs, but starts crying loudly if it senses danger. It stops when its ear covers are shut.

species.name: Loudred
species.description: When it stamps its feet and bellows, it generates ultrasonic waves that can blow apart a house.

species.name: Exploud
species.description: It emits a variety of sounds from the holes all over its body. Its loud cries can be heard from over six miles away.

species.name: Makuhita
species.description: It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy Pokémon that can withstand any attack.

species.name: Hariyama
species.description: It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.

species.name: Azurill
species.description: It battles by flinging around its tail, which is bigger than its body. The tail is a flotation device in water.

species.name: Nosepass
species.description: Its magnetic nose consistently faces north. Travelers check NOSEPASS to get their bearings.

species.name: Skitty
species.description: It is said to be difficult to earn its trust. However, it is extremely popular for its cute looks and behavior.

species.name: Delcatty
species.description: The favorite of trend-conscious female TRAINERS, they are used in competition for their style and fur.

species.name: Sableye
species.description: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

species.name: Mawile
species.description: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

species.name: Aron
species.description: It eats iron to build its steel body. It is a pest that descends from mountains to eat bridges and train tracks.

species.name: Lairon
species.description: It habitually shows off its strength with the size of sparks it creates by ramming its steel body into boulders.

species.name: Aggron
species.description: It claims a large mountain as its sole territory. It mercilessly thrashes those that violate its space.

species.name: Meditite
species.description: It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens its inner strength through meditation.

species.name: Medicham
species.description: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance- like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.

species.name: Electrike
species.description: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

species.name: Manectric
species.description: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.

species.name: Plusle
species.description: It cheers on partners while scattering sparks from its body. It climbs telephone poles to absorb electricity.

species.name: Minun
species.description: Its dislike of water makes it take shelter under the eaves of houses in rain. It uses pom-poms made of sparks for cheering.

species.name: Volbeat
species.description: It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear lights up. It converses with others by flashing its light.

species.name: Illumise
species.description: It guides VOLBEAT to draw signs in night skies. There are scientists that study the patterns it creates.

species.name: Roselia
species.description: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the ROSELIA is.

species.name: Gulpin
species.description: There is nothing its stomach can’t digest. While it is digesting, vile, overpowering gases are expelled.

species.name: Swalot
species.description: It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp. It secretes a horribly toxic fluid from the pores on its body.

species.name: Carvanha
species.description: It lives in massive rivers that course through jungles. It swarms prey that enter its territory.

species.name: Sharpedo
species.description: The ruffian of the seas, it has fangs that crunch through iron. It swims by jetting water from its rear.

species.name: Wailmer
species.description: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

species.name: Wailord
species.description: It is among the largest of all Pokémon. It herds prey in a pack then swallows the massed prey in one gulp.

species.name: Numel
species.description: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

species.name: Camerupt
species.description: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.

species.name: Torkoal
species.description: It burns coal inside its shell. If it is attacked, it belches thick, black smoke and flees.

species.name: Spoink
species.description: It apparently dies if it stops bouncing about. It carries a pearl from CLAMPERL on its head.

species.name: Grumpig
species.description: It can gain control over foes by doing odd dance steps. The black pearls on its forehead are precious gems.

species.name: Spinda
species.description: No two SPINDA are said to have identical patterns. It confuses foes with its stumbling motions.

species.name: Trapinch
species.description: It lives in arid deserts. It makes a sloping pit trap in sand where it patiently awaits prey.

species.name: Vibrava
species.description: It generates ultrasonic waves by violently flapping its wings. After making its prey faint, it melts the prey with acid.

species.name: Flygon
species.description: It hides itself by kicking up desert sand with its wings. Red covers shield its eyes from sand.

species.name: Cacnea
species.description: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

species.name: Cacturne
species.description: It lives in deserts. It becomes active at night when it hunts for prey exhausted from the desert’s heat.

species.name: Swablu
species.description: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

species.name: Altaria
species.description: If you hear a beautiful melody trilling deep among mountains far from people, it is ALTARIA’s humming.

species.name: Zangoose
species.description: If it comes across a SEVIPER, its fur bristles and it assumes its battle pose. Its sharp claws are its best weapon.

species.name: Seviper
species.description: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

species.name: Lunatone
species.description: Its health ebbs and flows with the lunar cycle. It brims with power when exposed to the light of the full moon.

species.name: Solrock
species.description: It absorbs solar energy during the day. Always expressionless, it can sense what its foe is thinking.

species.name: Barboach
species.description: It probes muddy riverbeds with its two long whiskers. A slimy film protects its body.

species.name: Whiscash
species.description: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything - if it is alive, WHISCASH will eat it.

species.name: Corphish
species.description: It came from overseas. It is a very hardy creature that will quickly proliferate, even in polluted streams.

species.name: Crawdaunt
species.description: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

species.name: Baltoy
species.description: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

species.name: Claydol
species.description: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

species.name: Lileep
species.description: It became extinct roughly 100 million years ago. It was regenerated from a fossil using advanced techniques.

species.name: Cradily
species.description: It ensnares prey with its eight tentacles. It then melts the prey with a strong acid before feeding.

species.name: Anorith
species.description: It is a kind of Pokémon progenitor. It uses its extending claws to catch prey hiding among rocks on the seafloor.

species.name: Armaldo
species.description: Protected by a hard shell, its body is very sturdy. It skewers prey with its claws to feed.

species.name: Feebas
species.description: Ridiculed for its shabby appearance, it is ignored by researchers. It lives in ponds choked with weeds.

species.name: Milotic
species.description: MILOTIC is breathtakingly beautiful. Those that see it are said to forget their combative spirits.

species.name: Castform
species.description: It has the ability to change its form into the sun, the rain, or a snow cloud, depending on the weather.

species.name: Kecleon
species.description: It changes body color to blend in with its surroundings. It also changes color if it is happy or sad.

species.name: Shuppet
species.description: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.

species.name: Banette
species.description: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a Pokémon. If it opens its mouth, its cursed energy escapes.

species.name: Duskull
species.description: Making itself invisible, it silently sneaks up to prey. It has the ability to slip through thick walls.

species.name: Dusclops
species.description: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

species.name: Tropius
species.description: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

species.name: Chimecho
species.description: It travels by riding on winds. It cleverly uses its long tail to pluck nuts and berries, which it loves to eat.

species.name: Absol
species.description: It appears when it senses an impending natural disaster. As a result, it was mistaken as a doom-bringer.

species.name: Wynaut
species.description: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

species.name: Snorunt
species.description: It is said that a home visited by a SNORUNT will prosper. It can withstand cold of minus 150 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.name: Glalie
species.description: It has a body of ice that won’t melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.

species.name: Spheal
species.description: Its body is covered in fluffy fur. The fur keeps it from feeling cold while it is rolling on ice.

species.name: Sealeo
species.description: It touches new things with its nose to test for smell and feel. It plays by spinning SPHEAL on its nose.

species.name: Walrein
species.description: It swims through icy seas while shattering ice floes with its large tusks. It is protected by its thick blubber.

species.name: Clamperl
species.description: It is protected by a sturdy shell. Once in a lifetime, it makes a magnificent pearl.

species.name: Huntail
species.description: It lives deep in the sea where no light ever filters down. It lights up its small fishlike tail to attract prey.

species.name: Gorebyss
species.description: Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant. With its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed that grows between rocks.

species.name: Relicanth
species.description: It has remained unchanged for 100 million years. It was discovered during a deep-sea exploration.

species.name: Luvdisc
species.description: During the spawning season, countless LUVDISC congregate at coral reefs, turning the waters pink.

species.name: Bagon
species.description: Its steel-hard head can shatter boulders. It longingly hopes for wings to grow so it can fly.

species.name: Shelgon
species.description: Its armored body makes all attacks bounce off. The armor is too tough, however, making it heavy and somewhat sluggish.

species.name: Salamence
species.description: It becomes uncontrollable if it is enraged. It destroys everything with shredding claws and fire.

species.name: Beldum
species.description: It uses magnetic waves to converse with its kind. All the cells in its body are magnetic.

species.name: Metang
species.description: It floats midair using magnetism. Its body is so tough, even a crash with a jet plane won’t leave a scratch.

species.name: Metagross
species.description: It is formed by two METANG fusing. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.

species.name: Regirock
species.description: It is entirely composed of rocks with no sign of a brain or heart. It is a mystery even to modern scientists.

species.name: Regice
species.description: Research revealed that its body is made of the same kind of ice that is found at the South Pole.

species.name: Registeel
species.description: It is sturdier than any kind of metal. It hardened due to pressure underground over tens of thousands of years.

species.name: Latias
species.description: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

species.name: Latios
species.description: It has a docile temperament and dislikes fighting. Tucking in its forelegs, it can fly faster than a jet plane.

species.name: Kyogre
species.description: This Pokémon is said to have expanded the sea by bringing heavy rains. It has the power to control water.

species.name: Groudon
species.description: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling KYOGRE.

species.name: Rayquaza
species.description: It has lived for hundreds of millions of years in the ozone layer. Its flying form looks like a meteor.

species.name: Jirachi
species.description: It is said to make any wish come true. It is awake for only seven days out of a thousand years.

species.name: Deoxys
species.description: This DEOXYS has transformed into its aggressive guise. It can fool enemies by altering its appearance.

species.name: Turtwig
species.description: Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.

species.name: Grotle
species.description: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.

species.name: Torterra
species.description: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.

species.name: Chimchar
species.description: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can’t extinguish the fire.

species.name: Monferno
species.description: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.

species.name: Infernape
species.description: Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It is beaten by none in terms of quickness.

species.name: Piplup
species.description: It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.

species.name: Prinplup
species.description: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

species.name: Empoleon
species.description: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.

species.name: Starly
species.description: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

species.name: Staravia
species.description: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

species.name: Staraptor
species.description: The muscles in its wings and legs are strong. It can easily fly while gripping a small Pokémon.

species.name: Bidoof
species.description: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

species.name: Bibarel
species.description: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.

species.name: Kricketot
species.description: It chats with others using the sounds of its colliding antennae. These sounds are fall hallmarks.

species.name: Kricketune
species.description: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

species.name: Shinx
species.description: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

species.name: Luxio
species.description: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

species.name: Luxray
species.description: When its eyes gleam gold, it can spot hiding prey--even those taking shelter behind a wall.

species.name: Budew
species.description: When it feels the sun’s warm touch, it opens its bud to release pollen. It lives alongside clear pools.

species.name: Roserade
species.description: Luring prey with a sweet scent, it uses poison whips on its arms to poison, bind, and finish off the prey.

species.name: Cranidos
species.description: It was resurrected from an iron ball-like fossil. It downs prey with its headbutts.

species.name: Rampardos
species.description: Its skull withstands impacts of any magnitude. As a result, its brain never gets the chance to grow.

species.name: Shieldon
species.description: It habitually polishes its face by rubbing it against tree trunks. It is weak to attacks from behind.

species.name: Bastiodon
species.description: When they lined up side by side, no foe could break through. They shielded their young in that way.

species.name: Burmy
species.description: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

species.name: Wormadam
species.description: Its appearance changes depending on where it evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body.

species.name: Mothim
species.description: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by Combee.

species.name: Combee
species.description: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please Vespiquen.

species.name: Vespiquen
species.description: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.

species.name: Pachirisu
species.description: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

species.name: Buizel
species.description: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

species.name: Floatzel
species.description: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

species.name: Cherubi
species.description: Sunlight colors it red. When the small ball is drained of nutrients, it shrivels to herald evolution.

species.name: Cherrim
species.description: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.

species.name: Shellos
species.description: Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.

species.name: Gastrodon
species.description: When its natural enemy attacks, it oozes purple fluid and escapes.

species.name: Ambipom
species.description: They work in large colonies and make rings by linking their tails, apparently in friendship.

species.name: Drifloon
species.description: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

species.name: Drifblim
species.description: It carries people and Pokémon when it flies. But since it only drifts, it can end up anywhere.

species.name: Buneary
species.description: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.

species.name: Lopunny
species.description: Extremely cautious, it quickly bounds off when it senses danger.

species.name: Mismagius
species.description: It chants incantations. While they usually torment targets, some chants bring happiness.

species.name: Honchkrow
species.description: If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called “Summoner of Night.”

species.name: Glameow
species.description: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

species.name: Purugly
species.description: It would claim another Pokémon’s nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.

species.name: Chingling
species.description: Each time it hops, it makes a ringing sound. It deafens foes by emitting high-frequency cries.

species.name: Stunky
species.description: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.

species.name: Skuntank
species.description: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

species.name: Bronzor
species.description: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor’s back contained a mysterious power.

species.name: Bronzong
species.description: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.

species.name: Bonsly
species.description: It prefers arid environments. It leaks water from its eyes to adjust its body’s fluid levels.

species.name: Mime Jr.
species.description: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy’s movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!

species.name: Happiny
species.description: It carries a round, egg-shaped rock in its belly pouch and gives the rock to its friends.

species.name: Chatot
species.description: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it’s one of them. This way they won’t attack it.

species.name: Spiritomb
species.description: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

species.name: Gible
species.description: It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who get too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.

species.name: Gabite
species.description: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

species.name: Garchomp
species.description: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

species.name: Munchlax
species.description: It hides food under its long body hair. However, it forgets it has hidden the food.

species.name: Riolu
species.description: It uses the shapes of auras, which change according to emotion, to communicate with others.

species.name: Lucario
species.description: By catching the aura emanating from others, it can read their thoughts and movements.

species.name: Hippopotas
species.description: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.

species.name: Hippowdon
species.description: It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of fearsome strength. It raises vast quantities of sand while attacking.

species.name: Skorupi
species.description: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

species.name: Drapion
species.description: It takes pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.

species.name: Croagunk
species.description: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

species.name: Toxicroak
species.description: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.

species.name: Carnivine
species.description: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

species.name: Finneon
species.description: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.

species.name: Lumineon
species.description: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.

species.name: Mantyke
species.description: The pattern on its back varies by region. It often swims in a school of Remoraid.

species.name: Snover
species.description: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain’s lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

species.name: Abomasnow
species.description: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as “The Ice Monster.”

species.name: Weavile
species.description: It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.

species.name: Magnezone
species.description: Sometimes the magnetism emitted by Magnezone is too strong, making them attract each other so they cannot move.

species.name: Lickilicky
species.description: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

species.name: Rhyperior
species.description: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

species.name: Tangrowth
species.description: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

species.name: Electivire
species.description: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

species.name: Magmortar
species.description: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

species.name: Togekiss
species.description: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.

species.name: Yanmega
species.description: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes’ heads instantly while flying by at high speed.

species.name: Leafeon
species.description: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you’ll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

species.name: Glaceon
species.description: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.

species.name: Gliscor
species.description: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

species.name: Mamoswine
species.description: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

species.name: Porygon-Z
species.description: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.

species.name: Gallade
species.description: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.

species.name: Probopass
species.description: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.

species.name: Dusknoir
species.description: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

species.name: Froslass
species.description: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees Fahrenheit. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.

species.name: Rotom
species.description: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

species.name: Uxie
species.description: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

species.name: Mesprit
species.description: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

species.name: Azelf
species.description: Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

species.name: Dialga
species.description: A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It is said that time began moving when Dialga was born.

species.name: Palkia
species.description: It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.

species.name: Heatran
species.description: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

species.name: Regigigas
species.description: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

species.name: Giratina
species.description: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.

species.name: Cresselia
species.description: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

species.name: Phione
species.description: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.

species.name: Manaphy
species.description: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

species.name: Darkrai
species.description: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.

species.name: Shaymin
species.description: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

species.name: Arceus
species.description: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.

species.name: Victini
species.description: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

species.name: Snivy
species.description: Being exposed to sunlight makes its movements swifter. It uses vines more adeptly than its hands.

species.name: Servine
species.description: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

species.name: Serperior
species.description: It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior’s noble eyes.

species.name: Tepig
species.description: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

species.name: Pignite
species.description: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.

species.name: Emboar
species.description: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

species.name: Oshawott
species.description: The scalchop on its stomach isn’t just used for battle--it can be used to break open hard berries as well.

species.name: Dewott
species.description: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

species.name: Samurott
species.description: In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs.

species.name: Patrat
species.description: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

species.name: Watchog
species.description: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

species.name: Lillipup
species.description: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.

species.name: Herdier
species.description: This very loyal Pokémon helps Trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.

species.name: Stoutland
species.description: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

species.name: Purrloin
species.description: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

species.name: Liepard
species.description: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

species.name: Pansage
species.description: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

species.name: Simisage
species.description: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.

species.name: Pansear
species.description: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

species.name: Simisear
species.description: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

species.name: Panpour
species.description: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.

species.name: Simipour
species.description: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

species.name: Munna
species.description: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

species.name: Musharna
species.description: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

species.name: Pidove
species.description: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one.

species.name: Tranquill
species.description: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.

species.name: Unfezant
species.description: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.

species.name: Blitzle
species.description: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

species.name: Zebstrika
species.description: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

species.name: Roggenrola
species.description: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

species.name: Boldore
species.description: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

species.name: Gigalith
species.description: The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.

species.name: Woobat
species.description: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

species.name: Swoobat
species.description: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.

species.name: Drilbur
species.description: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

species.name: Excadrill
species.description: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

species.name: Audino
species.description: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

species.name: Timburr
species.description: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.

species.name: Gurdurr
species.description: With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.

species.name: Conkeldurr
species.description: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

species.name: Tympole
species.description: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.

species.name: Palpitoad
species.description: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

species.name: Seismitoad
species.description: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

species.name: Throh
species.description: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

species.name: Sawk
species.description: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.

species.name: Sewaddle
species.description: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

species.name: Swadloon
species.description: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

species.name: Leavanny
species.description: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

species.name: Venipede
species.description: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.

species.name: Whirlipede
species.description: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

species.name: Scolipede
species.description: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.

species.name: Cottonee
species.description: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.

species.name: Whimsicott
species.description: They appear along with whirlwinds. They pull pranks, such as moving furniture and leaving balls of cotton in homes.

species.name: Petilil
species.description: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

species.name: Lilligant
species.description: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.

species.name: Basculin
